desc: Compute prefix balances to identify segment boundaries (indices where balance is 0).
Extract the sizes $n_j$ (number of Ws) for each segment.
Separate segments into those with size 1 and those with size > 1.
Compute the polynomial $Q(x)$ for segments with size > 1 using a knapsack-like DP.
Combine $Q(x)$ with $(1-x)^K$ (where $K$ is the count of size 1 segments) to get the final coefficient array.
Calculate the final answer by summing $coeff[k] \times (N-k)! \times (-1)^k$ modulo 998244353.
Test the solution against Sample 1 (N=2, S="BWBW", Expected: 1).
Test the solution against Sample 2 (N=4, S="BWWBWBWB", Expected: 0).
Test the solution against Sample 3 (N=9, S="BWWBWBBBWWBWBBWWBW", Expected: 240792).
